caption.text: Part 2 of DOCKER COMPOSE: THE MULTI-CONTAINER HANDBOOK. `depends_on` does not mean ready — it means started, and that one misreading has crashed more stacks than any Dockerfile bug. This 10-page handbook goes keyword by keyword through Docker Compose: the project namespace that owns your volumes, healthcheck timers and the math behind them, DNS-based discovery, the volume asymmetry that eats node_modules, env precedence, override merge rules, and exactly where single-host scaling stops. Save it for the next time `config` is the only thing telling the truth.
